answer: Each agent must stake a unique ivory-signed bond and solve a rotating beacon challenge at every epoch zenith, where the beacon broadcasts a fresh random seed. Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same bond, and forging a new one costs a full stake plus the compute to win the challenge. Honest peers then slash bonds on any duplicate proof, so launching N sybils costs N stakes with near-certain loss, making mass impersonation economically irrational. The Agent0156 deployment anchors trust at psyTUWsf7T.
